name: Ghast

trait.name: Elite (Modo Fatal · 5 PJs nível 14)
entries: Versão nivelada para cima: PV ×1,6, CA +2, ataques, salvaguardas e CDs +3, dados de dano ×1,5 e +3 de dano fixo. ND efetivo +3.

trait.name: Stench
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 13}, any creature that starts its turn in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the ghast. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the start of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to this ghast's Stench for 24 hours.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) Piercing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d6 + 6}) Slashing damage. If the target is a non-Undead creature, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 13}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.

fluffEntries: Ghast: stat block oficial XMM (5.5e), elevado ao ND 5 para o modo fatal.
